meta.note: Built from the working tree at 2a2a26cb, with uncommitted edits to DESIGN.md (the W-008 banner) and design/BRIEF.md.

color.note: One theme. Wombat has no dark theme and no prefers-color-scheme rule today. Names and values are app.css's :root custom properties, exactly as written, in source order.

tokens.name: primary-color
tokens.usage: Deep slate-navy ink, never an action colour (actions are `secondary-color`; DESIGN.md § Design tokens). Used for the dashboard figure (`.dashboard-metric-value`), the account wordmark (`.account-brand-text`) and the trajectory chart's dots; the browser theme-color #2c3e50 is the same value. As text: 10.98:1 on `surface-color`, 10.42:1 on `background-color`.

tokens.name: secondary-color
tokens.usage: The action colour: the `.btn-primary` fill, the `.btn-outline` border and label, the 2px rule under every page title (`.header-container`), the active `.tab-bar-tab`, the `.is-editing` and `.detail-card--emphasis` stripes, `.progress-bar-fill` and the trajectory line; also the text of `.alert-info` and `.badge-submitted`. `surface-color` on it 4.86:1. As text: 4.86:1 on `surface-color`, 4.61:1 on `background-color`, 4.55:1 on `info-bg`.

tokens.name: accent-color
tokens.usage: A lighter brand blue for soft accents and highlights. Declared in :root, but no rule in app.css reads it today. Not for text: 3.15:1 on `surface-color`.

tokens.name: success-color
tokens.usage: Done and succeeded: the `.btn-success` fill, `.status-dot.ok`, `.progress-bar-fill.is-complete`, the border of `.badge-standing-met`, and the text of `.alert-success` and `.badge-completed`. FAILS AA, kept as the source has it (task T322): as text on `success-bg` 2.55:1; `surface-color` label on it 2.87:1; as a mark on `surface-color` 2.87:1 and on the `hover-bg` progress track 2.73:1, under the 3:1 a meaningful mark needs.

tokens.name: danger-color
tokens.usage: Refused, failed, destructive: the `.btn-danger` fill, `.status-dot.err`, the invalid-field border and stripe, and the text of `.alert-danger`, `.badge-declined`, `.validation-summary-errors`, `.validation-message` and `.text-danger`. FAILS AA, kept as the source has it (T322): as text on `danger-bg` 3.57:1, on `surface-color` 3.82:1, on `background-color` 3.62:1; `surface-color` label on it 3.82:1. The invalid-field stripe passes 3:1 (3.82:1).

tokens.name: warning-color
tokens.usage: Wanting attention: the text of `.alert-warning` and `.badge-accepted`, `.status-dot.warn`, and the stripes of `.field-warning` and `.detail-card--warning` and the border of `.badge-standing-below` (decorative there: their words carry the meaning). FAILS AA, kept as the source has it (T322): as text on `warning-bg` 2.42:1; as a mark on `surface-color` 2.57:1.

tokens.name: info-color
tokens.usage: Declared in :root, but no rule reads it: `.alert-info` takes its text and border from `secondary-color`. Same value as `accent-color` and `focus-ring`.

tokens.name: background-color
tokens.usage: The page ground (`body`) and the shell's sticky top row. Text on it: `text-color` 11.99:1, `muted-text` 4.83:1, `link-color` 6.36:1.

tokens.name: surface-color
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, tables, dialogs and inputs; also the label colour on every filled button (`.btn-primary`, `.btn-success`, `.btn-danger`) and on the active tab. Text on it: `text-color` 12.63:1, `muted-text` 5.09:1, `link-color` 6.70:1.

tokens.name: text-color
tokens.usage: Body text, on `surface-color` (12.63:1), `background-color` (11.99:1), `header-bg` (11.36:1) and every tint (11.23 to 11.89:1). The one safe text colour on a tinted ground: `.badge-standing-*` and `.field-warning` already use it there, because the semantic colours on their own tints fall short.

tokens.name: muted-text
tokens.usage: Secondary text: `.page-subtitle` (and so every field's help text), `dt` labels in `.details-list`, the pager's summary, empty-state copy and the `.badge-draft` label. 5.09:1 on `surface-color`, 4.83:1 on `background-color` and `hover-bg`, 4.57:1 on `header-bg`; darkened for AA in T086, so nothing lighter.

tokens.name: link-color
tokens.usage: Every `a`. 6.70:1 on `surface-color`, 6.36:1 on `background-color`.

tokens.name: border-color
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card, table and container borders, row rules, the `.form-actions` rule, the dashed empty-state edge, the skeleton's middle stop. 1.30:1 on `surface-color`, so it is decoration only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: input-border
tokens.usage: The 1px border of `.form-control`, `.form-select` and `.search-input`. FAILS the 3:1 a control boundary needs, kept as the source has it (T322): 1.49:1 on `surface-color`, 1.42:1 on `background-color`.

tokens.name: shadow-color
tokens.usage: The one colour of every elevation (see Shadow).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px solid `:focus-visible` outline, 2px offset, on buttons, inputs, links and the focused result regions. 3.15:1 on `surface-color`; FAILS 3:1 on `background-color` at 2.99:1 (T322). The sidebar has no ring of its own, so nav links take this one: 4.46:1 on `sidebar-gradient-start`, 5.14:1 on `sidebar-gradient-end`.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind `.alert-danger`, `.badge-declined` and `.validation-summary-errors`. `text-color` on it 11.81:1; the source puts `danger-color` there (3.57:1, fails).

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind `.alert-success`, `.badge-completed` and `.badge-standing-met`. `text-color` on it 11.23:1; the source's `success-color` 2.55:1 fails.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind `.alert-warning`, `.badge-accepted`, `.badge-standing-below` and `.field-warning`. `text-color` on it 11.89:1; the source's `warning-color` 2.42:1 fails.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind `.alert-info` and `.badge-submitted`, whose `secondary-color` text reads at 4.55:1.

tokens.name: hover-bg
tokens.usage: Table-row hover, the `.badge-draft` and `.badge-standing-none` ground, the progress-bar track and the skeleton's ends. Same value as `background-color`.

tokens.name: header-bg
tokens.usage: The table header row (`.clinic-table th`) and the `.code-block` ground. `text-color` on it 11.36:1, `muted-text` 4.57:1.

tokens.name: sidebar-gradient-start
tokens.usage: Top of the sidebar's gradient (180deg, 0%), in NavMenu only. White on it 14.07:1; the nav's rgb(215 215 215) item text 9.78:1.

tokens.name: sidebar-gradient-end
tokens.usage: The sidebar gradient's violet end, reached at 70% and held to the bottom; NavMenu only. White on it 16.19:1; nav item text 11.25:1.

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: Fraunces (self-hosted, OFL) sets the wordmark only, never body copy. Always with font-optical-sizing: auto and font-variation-settings "SOFT" 0, "WONK" 1 (app.css --font-display-settings).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The sidebar lockup (`.navbar-brand`): white, beside the 40px mark, on the sidebar gradient.

styles.name: wordmark-large
styles.usage: The account-card lockup (`.account-brand-text`): `primary-color`, beside the 56px mark, on the sign-in, register and MSF respondent cards.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: All weight 600. app.css sets no line-height on headings or body, so browsers use normal (about 1.33 for Segoe UI); the specimens show the page's 1.4.

styles.name: account-title
styles.usage: The title of an account card (`.account-form-container h2`).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: The page title: one per page, from PageHeader, never larger; margin-bottom `space-md`.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings and the ConfirmDialog title; margin-bottom `space-sm`.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles (DashboardCard), a cluster fieldset's legend, `.state-panel-title`.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Sub-heads inside a card; margin-bottom `space-xs`.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: The smallest heading; margin-bottom `space-xs`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Encounters observed after the day count towards nothing.
styles.usage: Body copy in `text-color`. app.css sets no size: this is the browser's 16px.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Typed text in `.form-control` and `.search-input` (`.form-select` is 0.95rem).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: `.btn` labels.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: `muted-text`: `.page-subtitle` under the h1 and as every field's help text, `.pager-info`, `.state-panel-copy`, `.dashboard-metric-label`, table captions.

styles.name: nav-label
styles.usage: Sidebar nav items, rgb(215 215 215), white when active or hovered.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: `.text-sm`, `.validation-message`, `.field-warning`, `.progress-row-meta`, `.workflow-action-reasons`, `.search-hint`.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: `.btn-sm`: row actions, the pager, header actions on a detail page; `.form-select-sm` too.

styles.name: badge-label
styles.usage: `.badge` text: a state's label, never its key.

styles.name: button-xs
styles.usage: `.btn-xs`: the dismissible Alert's close button.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: `.dashboard-metric-value` in `primary-color`, over a `subtitle` label.

styles.name: chart-label
styles.usage: Trajectory chart axis labels, `muted-text`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: `.code-block`: stored text shown verbatim (an audit entry's JSON), on `header-bg`. `.font-mono` keeps the surrounding size.

spacing.note: app.css's --space-* scale; DESIGN.md: use these, not raw rem values. A handful of rules still write literals (the .btn padding 0.5rem 1rem, .alert padding 1rem, the 2rem and 1.5rem wide gutter).

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: 4px. Inside a figure (`.dashboard-metric`, `.progress-row-head`), under h4 and h5, the subtitle's top margin, and the side padding of a narrow inputs grid's cells.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: 8px. A field's label, control and help (`.form-group` gap), a button's icon gap, `.actions-cell`, `.tab-bar`, breadcrumbs; under h2 and h3; compact table cells.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: 16px. Table cell padding, the page's side gutter under 641px, `.detail-card--compact`, `.stack-list`, above `.form-actions`'s buttons; under the h1 and the page header's rule.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: 24px. `.detail-card` padding, the gaps of `.form-grid`, `.dashboard-grid`, `.details-grid` and `.search-grid`, under every `.alert`, the `.search-container` padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: 32px. `.form-container` padding, below `.header-container` and `.search-container`, above `.form-actions`, the empty-state card's padding.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: 48px. On the scale, but no rule reads it today (the auth page's 3rem padding is written literally).

radius.note: app.css declares no radius custom properties: these are the literal radii its classes write, named here by value so a design can cite them. To make one a token, add it to :root first (DESIGN.md § Design tokens).

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Skeletons, the progress bar, `.field-warning`, nav links.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Controls and messages: `.btn`, `.form-control`, `.form-select`, `.search-input`, `.alert`, `.validation-summary-errors`, `.code-block`.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: `.detail-card` (and so DashboardCard) and `.search-container`.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Large containers: `.table-container`, `.form-container`, `.account-form-container`, `.dialog-card`.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: `.badge` and `.tab-bar-tab`.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: `.status-dot`.

shadow.note: app.css declares no shadow custom properties: every shadow writes var(--shadow-color) inline. These are those shadows with shadow-color's value in place, plus the two inset stripes that mark a row or a field.

tokens.name: detail-card-shadow
tokens.usage: Cards and forms at rest: `.detail-card`, `.form-container`.

tokens.name: shadow-utility
tokens.usage: The `.shadow` utility: every `.table-container`, the MSF respondent's wide card.

tokens.name: interactive-hover-shadow
tokens.usage: `.detail-card--interactive:hover`, with a 2px lift (translateY(-2px), 0.15s ease).

tokens.name: account-card-shadow
tokens.usage: `.account-form-container`: the sign-in and register card.

tokens.name: error-bar-shadow
tokens.usage: The in-app error bar (`#blazor-error-ui`, MainLayout.razor.css).

tokens.name: invalid-stripe
tokens.usage: An invalid field: with its 1px `danger-color` border, a 4px stripe down the left, so the state is not colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1, T236). A shadow so the text does not move; forced-colors mode uses a 4px left border instead.

tokens.name: editing-stripe
tokens.usage: The first cell of an `.is-editing` table row and its form row: a `secondary-color` stripe tying them together (T176).

size.note: Fixed lengths the shell, grids and controls use. Not custom properties: written literally in MainLayout.razor.css, NavMenu.razor.css, app.css and Icon.razor; named here for reference. NarrowLayoutTests pins the shell values.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The NavMenu column from 641px up, sticky, full height.

tokens.name: top-row-height
tokens.usage: The shell's sticky top row (the user's name and Sign out).

tokens.name: nav-brand-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the sidebar's brand row.

tokens.name: nav-item-height
tokens.usage: Each sidebar nav link.

tokens.name: breakpoint-wide
tokens.usage: From here the shell is a row (sidebar beside main) and the gutter is 2rem left, 1.5rem right; at 640.98px and below the sidebar stacks above, the nav folds behind the CSS-only toggler, and detail lists go to one column.

tokens.name: breakpoint-details
tokens.usage: At 900px and below `.details-grid` is one column and `.dashboard-span-*` resets.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: `.btn` min-height (28px), so `.btn-sm` and `.btn-xs` stay above the 24px WCAG 2.5.8 target.

tokens.name: focus-outline
tokens.usage: Width of the solid `focus-ring` outline, and its offset.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Icon.razor's default size; 18px in a DashboardCard title, 1.25rem (20px) in the nav.

tokens.name: status-dot-size
tokens.usage: `.status-dot` diameter.

tokens.name: account-card-width
tokens.usage: `.account-form-container` max width (sign-in, register, change password).

tokens.name: account-card-wide-width
tokens.usage: `.account-form-container--wide`: the MSF respondent's questionnaire.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: `.dialog-card` max width (ConfirmDialog), and 100% less 2rem on a phone.

tokens.name: form-grid-min
tokens.usage: `.form-grid` column minimum, as min(250px, 100%); `.form-grid--wide` uses 350px.

tokens.name: dashboard-grid-min
tokens.usage: `.dashboard-grid` column minimum, as min(320px, 100%).

tokens.name: search-grid-min
tokens.usage: `.search-grid` column minimum, as min(220px, 100%); `.check-grid` uses 14rem.
